scope: harness and artifact schema only; no fused execution is asserted

current_harness.current_blocker: generic tiled fused attention lowering is not implemented
missing: QK and PV WMMA census from the executed model forward
executed program source and binary identities
attention-specific quality evidence bound to the same execution

minimal_harness_changes.change: Add --attention-admission PATH and --require-attention-route. The admission file supplies immutable expected identity/profile/context constraints only; it must not set an environment variable, mutate model configuration, or choose a lowering.

Add attention_request and attention_route_census. Keep shared_attention as a compatibility alias if needed. attention_route_census.v3 must record requested, observed selected_lowering, fallback_contract, candidate_id, model-forward identity, source and binary program identities, QK/PV WMMA counts, call count, resource-proof identity, and quality-gate identity.

Read observed values solely from a model/lowering-owned per-forward execution record. Default absent data to ordinary_sdpa/unknown and fail closed. Never promote selected_lowering from the supplied admission artifact or compiler-only evidence.

Add a separate attention_binding_gate. For a requested fused route, require admitted composite evidence, exact profile/context/candidate identity match, observed selected_lowering=fused_tiled_attention, at least one QK and one PV WMMA, one attention call, matched program identities, valid no-scratch/no-spill resource proof, and a PASS quality gate bound to the same model/input/candidate.
When --require-attention-route is set, require attention_binding_gate.status=PASS. Otherwise retain ordinary measurements but mark fused-attention promotion ineligible.

required_model_lowing_interface.name: SharedAttentionExecutionRecord
required_model_lowing_interface.ownership: scheduler/native lowering, emitted once per actual model-forward attention invocation
required_model_lowing_interface.note: This is an observability interface, not a route-selection policy change. Without it, the harness cannot honestly certify fused execution.

required_checks: VGPR bounds, positive LDS, no scratch, no spills
route census and full-output numeric PASS
admission_validation.restriction: Compiler capture and static composite admission are necessary supporting evidence, but are not proof that the benchmarked model forward selected the route.

fail_closed_contract.requested_fused_but_unobserved: attention_binding_gate FAIL; selected_lowering remains ordinary_sdpa or unknown
fail_closed_contract.default_nonfused_run: valid ordinary benchmark result; fused-attention promotion_eligible=false
